examples:

notes: deepsec globs such as '**/[[...rest]]/route.*' are minimatch character classes that never match the Next.js folder name; the port matches the folders literally with [[] and []]. deepsec reports the first line per router type; the port reports every line. Gate: deepsec tech [nextjs]; kalkan uses the tech tag next (or nextjs).
